audit_items.proof_trace: Data column sidecar validation (L2059-2065) calls verify_data_column_sidecar which only checks kzg_commitments is non-empty (eip_7594/src/lib.rs:162-164), not that len <= max_blobs_per_block(epoch). Blob sidecars have this check (store.rs:1839-1846), but data column sidecars do not, allowing attackers to submit sidecars with excessive commitments that pass basic validation but force expensive inclusion proof and KZG verification before eventual rejection.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker sends P2P data column sidecars with kzg_commitments count exceeding the epoch's max_blobs_per_block limit (e.g., 100 commitments when max is 15). Node accepts for validation, performs expensive verify_sidecar_inclusion_proof and verify_kzg_proofs operations, consuming CPU resources before the block-level validation would reject it.
